exposure: benign cervix uteri pathology in anamnesis
outcome: change in cervix uteri pattern post partum
regress of benign and premalignant changes in cervix uteri epithelium
cohort: The study included 195 women, comprising 146 pregnant patients with benign cervix uteri pathology in their history and a control group of 49 pregnant women, who were examined during pregnancy and 3-5 months postpartum.
finding: The study determined a relationship between the parity of pregnancy, delivery, route of delivery, and the regression of both benign and premalignant changes in the cervix uteri epithelium 3-5 months post partum.
mod_finding: The study determined a relationship between the route of delivery and the regress of both benign and premalignant changes in the cervix uteri epithelium 3-5 months post partum.
